QuestInfo.name: The Filing Error
QuestInfo.0: Rumor has it there is a hidden room above the #b#m010002003##k... I should keep an eye out for it next time I'm in there.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p326##k asked me to recover #b25 #t4031118##k the #rfairies#k took, then have #b#p202##k in #b#m010001000##k stamp the cover.\nI can probably find fairies in #b#m010002080##k, #b#m010002081##k, or #b#m010001005##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p202##k stamped the cover, but he doesn't want me returning to #b#p326##k with a damaged book.

0.0: Oh. A person. Hey. You're the first one to come up here this year. I was starting to think the monsters finally ate everyone.
0.1: I keep a book about adventurers. Where they went, what they did, who saw them last. I can add you if you want. It takes like a minute, and someone has to keep track of you all when you wander into the deep woods.
0.2: No one ever comes back to tell me how their story ends. So the book is mostly just beginnings. \nWhich is fine. Beginnings are the best part anyway.
0.3: We have a problem, though. The fairies have been tearing out pages to make nests. Also, it rained on it. So my book is ruined. I'm probably going to trap a fairy in a jar later.
0.4: I need about #b25#k #b#t4031118##k back before I can fix it. You can find them by defeating #rfairies#k.\n You can probably find some in #b#m010002080#, #b#m010002081##k, or #b#m010001005##k. Will you go get them?

yes.0: Cool. Oh, before you bring them back, the cover needs a stamp. Go to #b#p202##k in #b#m010001000##k. He yells a lot, but he has the stamp.

no.0: Oh. Okay. I guess I'll just painstakingly tape it back together myself over the next five years, then.

1.0: What do you want? Speak up, I'm a busy man.
1.1: ...That book. #b#p326##k sent this, did she? Hand it here.
1.2: The cover's sound enough, so I'll stamp it. But you can't bring this back to Lyn in this state!
1.3: Don't look at me like that. Look at the state of these pages! Soaked, torn, half of them blank. She deserves better!
1.4: If you want it stamped properly, you'll go and fill in what's missing yourself. Find the people the entries name. They can tell you what the pages can't.

npc.0: Please collect the missing pages and deliver them to #b#p202##k!

item.0: You've lost something important?\nDo not worry. An adventurer seems to have found some pages from a ledger during their travels.
